verdict.rationale: Agent-oriented docs such as llms.txt are a fair ask for a SaaS HR/payroll platform, so the axis applies. A direct probe of help.justworks.com/llms.txt returned HTTP 404, and no OpenAPI spec was found at any candidate path. The docs evidence covers only end-user help-center articles about payroll, benefits, time off and Xero, with nothing about agent-oriented documentation.
